_comment_live_usage: Query the official usage endpoints with the CLIs' own tokens (sent only to api.anthropic.com / chatgpt.com). Set a source to false to rely on that CLI's local cache only. Intervals are in seconds (minimum 60); both endpoints throttle faster pollers.
_comment_codex_prices: USD per 1M tokens: [input, output, cached_input_multiplier]. Empty = show tokens only.
_comment_claude_prices: Optional overrides, same shape. Built-in table already covers current Claude models.
